---
title: "OSMnx · Find routes"
---

::: {.lead}
Shortest paths across the Burjassot network, alternatives, route metrics, and
bulk origin-destination pairs. Mirrors the
[Routing panel](../../../panels/osmnx/routing.qmd).
:::

Needs a `drive` network with **Edge Speeds** and **Travel Times** already
computed ([Add edge attributes](attributes.qmd)), or time-based routing has
nothing to work with.

## 1. Pick origin and destination

**Select Source** and **Select Target** are eyedroppers: press one, click a node
in the viewport. The node IDs appear in the panel.

![Selecting source and target nodes with the eyedroppers.](../../../assets/guides/osmnx/04-select-od.png)

## 2. Shortest path

**Path Weight** decides what "shortest" means: **length** for distance,
**travel_time** for time.

![A shortest path highlighted across the network.](../../../assets/guides/osmnx/04-shortest-path.png)

::: {.callout-note}
The **elevation_impedance** weight needs edge grades; see the
[Elevation tutorial](elevation.qmd).
:::

## 3. Alternative routes

**K Shortest Paths** draws **K** distinct alternatives (default `3`) between the
same endpoints.

![Three alternative routes between the same endpoints.](../../../assets/guides/osmnx/04-k-shortest.png)

## 4. Route summary

Reports the active route's length, travel time, mean absolute grade and rise.

![Route Summary reports length, time and grade.](../../../assets/guides/osmnx/04-route-summary.png)

## 5. Batch routing

**Random N** is how many OD pairs to sample and **Batch CPUs** how many to route
in parallel. The result is aggregate statistics rather than drawn routes.

![Batch routing many random OD pairs.](../../../assets/guides/osmnx/04-batch.png)
